label: No placebo
rationale: This is a single-group interventional study in which eligible patients receive only the antioxidant regimen. The record describes an open treatment arm and gives no placebo or sham comparator, so the design supports no placebo control.

evidence.quote: Eligible patients will receive over-the-counter anti-oxidants
